summary: Explored PortalSifast hybrid aset schema vs create-form completeness. Migration create_aset_tables defines aset_ruang, aset_barang (with FK strings kode_produsen/id_merk/id_kategori/id_jenis), aset (harga, asal, kondisi, etc.), and aset_foto. StoreAsetRequest accepts harga and barang fields but create.tsx UI only shows nama/ruang/tahun/kelas/kalibrasi; harga/asal/tanggal/kondisi sit in form state unused. SinkronAsetDariSimrs maps SIMRS ruang/barang/inventaris/gambar into portal; no local aset_merk/produsen/jenis/kategori masters (SIMRS masters exist separately). No CSV import for aset—only SIMRS sync. Gaps vs wanted fields: nomenclature partial, merk/type not on create, harga backend-only, jumlah/serial/distributor absent, foto post-create only.
current_status: Aset hybrid portal has schema + sync + basic create; complete create form still needs UI for existing accepted fields, master lookups for merk/jenis, and new columns for serial/distributor/jumlah if required.
